items.title: Upwind DG transport satisfies the semidiscrete L2 energy identity
items.statement:
Let $d\ge1$. If $d=1$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite oriented interval mesh of $\Omega=(a,b)$, $a<b$, from [[def-pe04-one-dimensional-interval-mesh-and-broken-polynomials]]; if $d\ge2$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite matching affine simplicial mesh of $\Omega$. Let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let $u_h$ solve [[def-pe04-upwind-dg-transport-discretization]] with inflow data $g$. Assume Countable Choice when $d\ge2$, as required by the affine-simplex Green supplier; no choice assumption is needed for the interval branch. Write $\Gamma_+=\{x\in\partial\Omega:\beta\cdot n>0\}$ and $\Gamma_- =\{x\in\partial\Omega:\beta\cdot n<0\}$. For an interior facet $F=K^-\cap K^+$ choose a unit normal $n_F$ from $K^-$ to $K^+$ and write $[u_h]=u_h^+-u_h^-$. In dimension one, integrals over facets and boundary points mean sums with respect to zero-dimensional surface measure. Then
$$\frac12\frac{d}{dt}\sum_{K\in\mathcal T_h}\|u_h\|_{L^2(K)}^2+\frac12\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\int_F|\beta\cdot n_F|[u_h]^2\,dS+\frac12\int_{\Gamma_+}(\beta\cdot n)u_h^2\,dS+\frac12\int_{\Gamma_-}|\beta\cdot n|(u_h-g)^2\,dS=\frac12\int_{\Gamma_-}|\beta\cdot n|g^2\,dS.$$
In particular, zero inflow data give a nonincreasing semidiscrete $L^2$ norm. This result is semidiscrete and makes no claim about a time integrator.
items.strategy: Use the actual simplex Green identity and opposite interior normals, then calculate each signed upwind face contribution.

items.title: Upwind SBP-SAT transport satisfies the semidiscrete L2 energy identity
items.statement:
Let $d\ge1$. If $d=1$, let the cells be a finite oriented interval mesh from [[def-pe04-one-dimensional-interval-mesh-and-broken-polynomials]]; if $d\ge2$, let them form a finite matching affine simplicial mesh. On every cell assume diagonal-norm SBP data of [[def-pe04-diagonal-norm-sbp-element-data]], with paired interior face nodes, equal paired weights, and opposite outward normals. Let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let the differentiable nodal state $U_K(t)$ solve the upwind SBP-SAT method of [[def-pe04-upwind-sbp-sat-transport-discretization]] with prescribed inflow values $g_{F,q}$ where $b_{K,F}:=\beta\cdot n_{K,F}<0$. Write $\omega_{F,q}$ for the diagonal entries of the face norm. On an interior face oriented from $K^-$ to $K^+$, set $b_F=\beta\cdot n_F$ and $[U]_{F,q}=U^+_{F,q}-U^-_{F,q}$. Let $\Gamma_+$ and $\Gamma_-$ denote the boundary faces with positive and negative outward speed, respectively. For $d=1$, each face has one endpoint node and its face sum is a one-point sum. The discrete energy $E_h=\frac12\sum_K U_K^TH_KU_K$ satisfies
$$\frac{dE_h}{dt}+\frac12\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}|b_F|[U]_{F,q}^2+\frac12\sum_{F\subset\Gamma_+}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}b_{K,F}U_{F,q}^2+\frac12\sum_{F\subset\Gamma_-}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}|b_{K,F}|(U_{F,q}-g_{F,q})^2=\frac12\sum_{F\subset\Gamma_-}\sum_q\omega_{F,q}|b_{K,F}|g_{F,q}^2.$$
Consequently, zero inflow data give a nonincreasing SBP norm.
items.strategy: Contract the matrix ODE with the state, apply the stated SBP identity, and pair the two traces at each interface.

items.title: Smooth-solution L2 error bound for upwind DG transport
items.statement:
Let $d\ge1$. If $d=1$, let $\Omega=(a,b)$, $a<b$, have a finite oriented interval mesh $\mathcal T_h$ from [[def-pe04-one-dimensional-interval-mesh-and-broken-polynomials]]; if $d\ge2$, let $\mathcal T_h$ be a finite matching affine simplicial mesh of $\Omega$. Let $\beta\in\mathbb R^d$ be constant, and let $u\in C^1([0,T]\times\overline\Omega)$ solve $u_t+\beta\cdot\nabla u=0$ with inflow data equal to its boundary trace. Assume Countable Choice for the imported affine-simplex Green and Lebesgue-measure suppliers; the full-support and finite-measure properties on each cell are established below. Let $u_h$ be the semidiscrete upwind DG solution of degree $p\ge0$, and let $\Pi_h$ be the cellwise L2 projection with respect to Lebesgue measure on each cell. Use $\|w\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2=\sum_K\int_K|w|^2\,dx$ and put $\eta=\Pi_hu-u$. For an interior face with chosen normal $n_F$, let $\eta^{\mathrm{up}}$ be the trace of $\eta$ from the upwind side. In dimension one, face and boundary integrals are sums with respect to zero-dimensional surface measure. Define
$$R_h(t)^2=\sum_{F\text{ interior}}\int_F|\beta\cdot n_F|\,|\eta^{\mathrm{up}}|^2\,dS+\int_{\Gamma_+}(\beta\cdot n)|\eta|^2\,dS.$$
Then
$$\|u_h(T)-u(T)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}\le\left(\|u_h(0)-\Pi_hu(0)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2+2\int_0^TR_h(t)^2\,dt\right)^{1/2}+\|\Pi_hu(T)-u(T)\|_{L^2(\Omega)}.$$
This is an exact projection-trace residual bound. It asserts no mesh-order rate unless the displayed projection errors are separately estimated.
items.strategy: Subtract the exact weak equation, use cellwise projection orthogonality to cancel volume residuals, and absorb face residuals with upwind dissipation.
